speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to start our evaluation, on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is this pain, and which specific part of your leg does it travel to?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression). REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Lumbosacral Spine. REQUEST TEST: Straight Leg Raise Test.
